conceptZh: 圓滾滾的小選手起腳高高踢起足球，足球在空中頂部定格化為「口」字框，小選手伸展的身軀與腿部順勢凝結成「足」字下半部的筆劃。
object: a playful character kicking a soccer ball high into the air
morph: the soccer ball pauses at its apex to form the top square box '口', while the character's torso and outstretched legs stretch into the central stem and lower sweeping strokes of '足'
creativeAngle: 採用家長建議的踢足球情境，將動態踢球過程轉化為結構清晰的文字演變。頂部高飛的足球形成「口」，軀幹與踢球伸展的雙腳自然變成豎、橫與底部的撇捺，既生動又嚴謹呈現「足」字正確結構。
promptEn: An 8-second 2D animation for children aged 6-8 featuring high-contrast, clean visual design on a light pastel background. From 0 to 2 seconds, a cheerful centered character kicks a soccer ball high up into the air. From 2 to 5 seconds, the soccer ball pauses at its peak in the upper-center and morphs into a crisp, solid indigo square box forming the top '口' radical of the Traditional Chinese character '足'. At the same time, the character's body and kicking legs stretch into solid indigo strokes, forming the lower central stem, horizontal bar, and bottom sweeping legs. By 5 seconds, the transformation completes into the accurate, bold Traditional Chinese character '足', centered and filling 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins. From 5 to 8 seconds, the animation holds entirely static on '足' for at least 3 seconds while a friendly Taiwanese Mandarin voiceover clearly pronounces 'zú, zú, zú, zú' four times. The composition remains clean, bright, without white blowouts, flashing effects, watermarks, or extra text.

conceptZh: 頑皮水管偏要洗消防隊員的腳底，讓他笑得單腳跳；重新握好水管後，大家終於洗出清楚的「足」。
object: A chunky toy fire engine, its determined toy firefighter crew, a mischievous hose, and one large relief glyph.
morph: A thin sandy coating washes off a fixed, correctly formed relief of 足, revealing solid cobalt-blue strokes without bending or rearranging them.
creativeAngle: 改用洗字時水管偷搔腳底的玩具鬧劇，取代踢球變字。字形由固定浮雕保證正確，笑點先完成，再留下完整辨識時間；洗腳的動作連結「足」的意思。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized toy animation in one locked, front-facing shot. On a light apricot background, center a large, correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 足, occupying approximately 70% of frame height with comfortable margins. It is a shallow cobalt-blue relief with a thin sandy surface coating; its complete silhouette and open spaces are recognizable from the beginning. Use an accurate Traditional Chinese typeface as the fixed geometry, preserving every stroke and gap throughout.

At the lower left stands an original chunky coral-red toy fire engine with expressive windshield eyes and two unmistakably molded-plastic firefighter figures. Their oversized helmets, mitten hands and broad bare toy feet give them a cheerful, determined personality. The engine's flexible hose has a mischievously independent nozzle. The relief is the only additional object.

During 0.0–1.2 seconds, the crew braces proudly to wash the towering glyph. One firefighter grips the nozzle while the other steadies the hose. After a tiny anticipation pause, the nozzle curls downward instead of aiming forward. During 1.2–2.7 seconds, its gentle water jet tickles the first firefighter's exposed sole. The startled toy lifts that foot, then comically hops once on the other foot while the nozzle follows the raised sole. Use a broad silent laughing expression and a soft rubber squeak; the engine gives an exaggerated windshield-eye double-take. Keep this action small and below the central strokes.

During 2.7–4.4 seconds, the firefighter plants both feet and firmly redirects the nozzle with help from the crewmate. A single controlled wash travels across the relief, removing the sandy coating and exposing uniformly saturated cobalt-blue strokes. The fixed top enclosure and precise lower stroke structure remain intact; water never becomes a stroke. The crew and hose retreat out of frame by 4.4 seconds, with all droplets settled.

Hold the finished 足 perfectly still, centered and unobstructed from 4.4–8.0 seconds. A warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly: 「足、足、足球」. Schedule the first 足 around 4.5 seconds, the second around 5.4 seconds, and 足球 around 6.4–7.3 seconds, with natural short pauses. The vocabulary is audio only. Display only 足, with no subtitles, additional lettering, logos or watermarks. Use bright, soft lighting, restrained water sounds, no flashing effects and no music.

conceptZh: 玩具消防員只想把小足球輕輕推一下，卻把水管開到最大，反衝力把整台消防車推得衝過頭撞上邊框，震飛的紅色梯子橫桿掉下來剛好排成「足」，最後他改用小腳輕輕一踢，球就乖乖滾好了。
object: a chunky toy fire engine with a jittery molded-plastic firefighter figure, an over-powered hose, a tiny soccer ball, and the engine's red roof ladder whose bars break loose
morph: the full-blast recoil rockets the engine past the ball into a BONK; the shaken-loose red ladder bars tumble and clatter into place as the 口 box on top and the vertical, short horizontal, left stroke and long sweeping stroke below, forming 足
creativeAngle: 走「力氣太大」路線：上一版是水管搔腳底、洗出字，這次改成實際的衝過頭、撞擊、輪胎冒煙滑回來，用撞散的梯子橫桿排出字形。結尾不用水管，改用小腳輕輕一踢足球，所以「腳」的字義和「足球」這個詞同時出現在畫面上。小外星人這次不出場，讓畫面保持簡單。
promptEn:
An 8-second stylized 3D toy animation in one locked, front-facing shot on a soft cream background with a pale floor line. The cast is a chunky glossy-red toy fire engine with big windshield eyes and one molded-plastic firefighter figure (oversized yellow helmet, mitten hands, round rubber boots) who reads clearly as a toy. The engine's red roof ladder rattles loosely. A small black-and-white soccer ball sits just right of center, one tiny nudge away from a little toy goal at the right edge.

0.0–1.6s: The firefighter points at the ball, nods importantly, then cranks the engine's pump wheel three times. The wheel spins faster with each crank while the engine's eyes widen and the hose swells like a balloon.

1.6–3.0s: The hose fires a huge cartoon water blast backward, and the recoil rockets the whole engine left to right across the frame with the firefighter clinging on, streaking straight past the ball, which only wobbles. A frozen beat, then BONK: the engine squashes flat against the right edge, springs back, and skids back to the left with little puffs of smoke from its tires. The firefighter grins, dizzy, with swirly eyes.

3.0–4.6s: The BONK shakes seven bright red ladder bars loose. They spin up into the air, then clatter down to center and land exactly as the Traditional Chinese character 足: four bars make the square 口 on top, and the rest settle into the short vertical, the short right horizontal, the left stroke and the long sweeping stroke below. Each lands with a crisp wooden click. The glyph is correctly formed and centered, fills about 70% of frame height with even margins, and shows solid saturated red strokes on the light background. The engine and firefighter end up small in the lower-left margin.

4.6–5.4s: The firefighter tiptoes to the ball, which sits in the lower-right margin clear of every stroke, and gives it one gentle tap with a tiny rubber boot. The ball rolls neatly into the little goal.

5.0–8.0s: 足 holds perfectly still and unobstructed. The firefighter does a small happy hop in the corner, and the engine wipes its smoking tires with a wiggle.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「足、足、足球」 (ㄗㄨˊ、ㄗㄨˊ、ㄗㄨˊ ㄑㄧㄡˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones and short pauses, and nothing else. The first 足 comes at about 3.1s as the bars fly up, the second 足 at about 4.4s as the last bar clicks into place, and 足球 at about 5.2s exactly as the boot taps the ball. Add soft cartoon boings, the clicks and a gentle water whoosh with no loud startling sounds and no music. The only text on screen is the single glyph 足: no subtitles, no other lettering, no logos, no watermark. Use bright, soft lighting with no flashing and no white blowouts.
